name: EncryptRequest
description: A request to encrypt a plaintext payload using a managed customer master key. Models the common shape used by AWS KMS Encrypt, Google Cloud KMS Encrypt, Azure Key Vault encrypt, and HashiCorp Vault Transit encrypt operations.

key_id.description: Identifier of the CMK or named key used to encrypt the payload.

plaintext.description: Base64-encoded plaintext to be encrypted. Implementations typically cap this at 4 KiB; larger payloads should use envelope encryption with a generated data key.

encryption_context.description: Additional authenticated data (AAD) bound to the ciphertext. Same context must be provided to decrypt.

grant_tokens.description: Optional grant tokens authorizing this operation.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request without performing the encryption.
